title: Incels: A Philosophy for Idiots
summary: Long philosophical essay (episode 2 of 'A Philosophy for Idiots') in which NH, a self-described former incel, argues that inceldom is a chosen resentment-based mindset rooted in arrested development, poor male socialization and the breakdown of masculinity, illustrated through a reading of Elliot Rodger's 141-page manifesto. He also criticizes society's double standards toward incels and argues women share some responsibility, concluding that resentment from either sex is destructive and that the cure is understanding and personal change.
claims: The script for this video took about 5 months and 25 pages to write before he cut it down
NH says he used to be an incel and speaks from that personal perspective
Incels hate former incels most, more than themselves or women, because an ex-incel is proof that escape was possible
The core problem behind most miserable lives, including incels, is willpower: they deny the one factor that would get them out of the hole
Incels project their personal failures onto women so they never have to face them, making women responsible for their happiness
Neediness born from their situation is exactly what makes incels repulsive to women; attention should be a happy byproduct of becoming someone worth loving
Your misery is your own responsibility, and the thing you think will fix you (women's attention) will not fix you
Getting a dog helps an incel not because of meeting dog owners but because it redirects attention outside himself, gives him responsibility for something weaker and socializes him
Masculinity is essentially providing service for people who need it more than you do
His glow-up (growth spurt to 6 feet, better looks) did not improve his dating life and actually forced him to admit his character was the problem
Socialization and interpersonal skills were the number one factor that got him out of inceldom, not becoming more attractive
Across his life, whether fat or lean, his attractiveness never correlated with success with women; mental health and interpersonal skills always did
He has known rich, good-looking friends who were very unpopular with women because of their persona and attitude
Being an incel is a choice: it is a mindset that offers a reward, in Adlerian terms a psychic goal that comforts now but harms later
Incels replace society's value system with a parallel one whose currency is misery, rejecting anyone who escapes
Incel pride in failure is an example of Nietzschean slave morality: valuing what you have because you cannot meet society's standards
Incels suffer more under patriarchal values than anyone: no partners, children, land, capital, social power or traditionally male virtues
Incels are a product of the last 20-30 years of social change, the men left behind by a transformed patriarchy
Incels are the only downtrodden group routinely told their misery is their own fault, because they are men
He saw a figure that most men 25 and under have never asked a woman out, whereas he and his friends asked out dozens
Men also need affection and physical contact; many men cannot remember their last hug
Nobody is owed a sexual partner, yet telling suffering men they are entitled and should die alone only makes them more vicious
Manosphere influencers keep incels miserable with hypergamy excuses because misery drives more content consumption, like selling water that makes you thirsty
Man up is blackmail that uses traditional masculinity to keep men productive; it fails on incels because society offers them no carrot
Ignoring incels as losers is dangerous if their numbers keep growing
Incels who say that letting go of resentment means abandoning their identity prove resentment is the core of the incel identity
Elliot Rodger's manifesto shows inceldom is not socioeconomic: he was wealthy and privileged
Inceldom is a form of arrested development; modern society lacks rites of passage into manhood
Women quickly sense Peter Pan syndrome in men and do not want to be their mother
Incels want women for status in the eyes of other men rather than for companionship; loneliness alone does not make someone an incel
Healthy adults understand the internal world drives decisions; incels let the external world justify everything
He suspects most incels come from divorced households and boys raised mostly by women lack masculine role models
NH was raised by women, felt maladapted and lost in the masculine world as a boy, and became an incel
Incels often suffer from intelligence: smart enough to see how society makes them losers, not self-aware enough to see their role
Jealousy stems from entitlement plus feelings of inferiority
Consoling a boy's jealous tantrums instead of redirecting them produces unstable boys rather than sensitive ones
Some social traits healthy in women are maladaptive in men, and women share some responsibility in creating incels
Rodger had no identity of his own, only whatever he thought would make him liked; self-worth must come from within
Incels are made, not born, so the process can be reversed; most are nonviolent and mainly dangerous to themselves
Blaming incels for the state of modern dating is like blaming poor people for a collapsing economy
Society treats women's safety as a political issue while saying men are not owed love, a patriarchal double standard
He swapped genders in highly upvoted feminist Reddit comments to show resentment reads the same as incel forum posts
Resentment, regardless of source or sex, is always destructive because it stops self-reflection and focuses on external factors
The cure is understanding that it is not men against women but both together
He has been inconsistent with uploads partly because he is very busy with his strategy work
